snippet.title: All The Glory - Star Wars Episode 2 - Battle of Cloned Humans Long Play [010]
snippet.description:
Oh Sintax, I bet you thought Star Wars Episode 2 was going to be the hit of the summer when you swapped out Ryu Hayabusa for anakin Skywalker... But just like that movie, you're game's a little bit of a train wreck! But hey, fireball throwing Darth Vader!

This is the 10th episode of All The Glory, the Long Play Series with no deaths, no commentary, but All The Glory! From start to end, we play the rare, the valuable & the classic games so you can make up you're mind if they're something to spend your hard earned pennies on!

You can find more Gameboyle goodness on Twitter - @GameBoyle and find us on Facebook at facebook.com/boyographic
